name: Sparkling Lemonade with Fresh Herbs
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: A few leaves of fresh mint and/or lemon balm (Melissa officinalis)

steps: Juice the lemons, and dissolve the sugar in the juice.
Add carbonated water and the fresh herb leaves.

culture.text: Herbs are a widely distributed and widespread group of plants, excluding vegetables, with savory or aromatic properties that are used for flavoring and garnishing food, for medicinal purposes, or for fragrances. Culinary use typically distinguishes herbs from spices. Herbs generally refers to the leafy green or flowering parts of a plant, while spices are usually dried and produced from other parts of the plant, including seeds, bark, roots and fruits.
